scope: Preedge actual phase/valid/row_valid and, for prefetched R, operand_valid/fetch_done samples during identical source-bound public schedules. Product slots require their actual write enable; V product writes occur only in M_EXEC, operand/total/rounded slots use their separate phases; R operand slots include pipeline fill and single-fetch phases. Function valid tokens counted for each2lane stage, allocated slots include odd tail padding. Ratios may use stated total/phase cycle denominators. These are logical enable/token occupancy, not transistor switching, power, gate-netlist occupancy, or model/system performance.
